payload.title: Router: recover stories after an operator retry of provider_failed decisions
payload.description:
Needed before Cyclotron PR 193 and its retry command deploy. Cyclotron has promised to warn first; both wait on Ryan approving the change set.

Behaviour reported by the Cyclotron session, not yet run against Papyrus:
- provider_failed arrives as a top-level 409 on GET /machine/decisions/{jobId}. monitoring_router classify makes that ItemRetryLater, so the route keeps polling the same job with backoff.
- That receipt never changes, so polling never produces a decision. The router must drop the job and re-post.
- command_recovery retry-failed --run ... --apply authorizes the retry and makes no provider call. After that, the same item under a new request ID gets a real decision.
- A re-post before the authorization gets source_refused, which the router treats as final. So never re-post automatically.
- Papyrus cannot see the authorization, so the trigger must come from the operator: for example a reopen of those routes after the retry, on the signed-in CLI path.

Also report these routes as waiting on an operator rather than as ordinary backoff. Gherkin required.
